title.narrative: Liberia Investment, Finance and Trade Project

description.narrative: The US$40 million Liberia Investment, Finance and Trade (LIFT) Project (the “Project”) is a World Bank (IDA) project in support of Liberia's private and financial sectors, and the first operation for the main beneficiaries, the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (MOCI), and Central Bank of Liberia (CBL). The four components focus on: (1) trade and investment enabling environment; (2) SME access to market and finance; (3) digital financial services infrastructure; and (4) program implementation, M&E and contingency emergency response.
To improve the investment?climate, expand sustainable?access to finance, and increase the efficiency of trade in Liberia

condition.narrative: Section 1A.5.a The Recipient shall not later than thirty (30) days from the Effectiveness Date, establish and thereafter maintainthroughout the implementation of the Project, a PTC comprising representatives from the TIMA and ensure that the PTC has resourcesand personnel required to enable it to perform its functions under the Project.

Section IA.2.a( ii) ensure that no later than ninety (90) days from the Effectiveness Date, recruit and thereafter maintainthroughout the implementation of the Project, a monitoring and evaluation specialist, communications specialist and climateco-benefits specialist, all with experience and under terms of reference satisfactory to the Association to support the PIU.

Section IA.4.a The Recipient shall not later than thirty (30) days from the Effectiveness Date establish and thereafter maintainthroughout the implementation of the Project, the PSC comprising representatives from MoCI, MFDP, CBL, and the private sector; and(ii) ensure that the PSC has resources and personnel required to enable it to perform its functions under the Project.

Section IV. A The Recipient shall not later than six (6) months from the Effectiveness Date, conduct an assessment of theenvironmental and social capacity of the PFIs, SMEs, TIMAs and other project beneficiaries; and develop and implement atraining/capacity building plan satisfactory to the Association to address the identified capacity gaps.
